scope.RESOURCE_ID: the proposal bodies, reversible delta, report and index
scope.ALLOWED_ACTION: create and full readback of detached proposal blobs only
scope.ROLLBACK: Apply no additions. Until Root admits a tree, preserve every ref, tree, commit and run as-is.

review.scenario: Read the unchanged M01 vector. Use a bodyless native Request at a fixed .invalid URL, a plain lease object, and one synthetic Error with the original wire text and status. Create the original-shaped local native pending Response.json with native Headers. The actual factory's enter returns the cell. Subsequent calls are bind, deadline, race, caught and finish, retaining their original argument identities throughout.
review.assertion: The actual response status and legacy g1 are read and asserted first. Then the native response Headers are read at x-afw-lab-pending1 and strict equality to the sealed row is asserted. Static intent is child exit 1 with ERR_ASSERTION and actual null only for an expected feature-missing RED. Captured stage, code and operands are required. No test output was generated by the author.

extraction.lines: 692 through before 772 inclusive of both terminating LF bytes
extraction.dependencies: No external Source module imports in the slice. Real platform Request/Response/Headers and JavaScript primitives.

review.containment: The parent stages three pinned files only, verifies their exact data/real paths, and launches the test by an absolute Node path in fresh PID/network namespaces with only loopback structure and a clean seven-key env. Nonroot original runner IDs, cleared supplementary groups, zero effective capabilities and no-new-privs are checked in the child before importing the exact slice. Source process is PID 1 of its namespace, and its host PID absence follows synchronous reap before matching stage files and removing private temp. Closure is confined to that modeled process and temp scope.
review.evidence: Expected RED requires empty child stderr, a single bounded child frame, normal child exit 1 with no signal or spawn error, all custody checks, observed 503/g1, and the exact private assertion failure. The runner writes a fixed regular file, reads it back, and emits one bounded base64 carrier for the exact same bytes. Unexpected outcomes receive a separate disposition. Always upload with a failed job and retain the actual exit evidence.
review.inventory: One parent runner, three serial Git reads, one isolated child test, and one Source module imported in that same child. Launch utilities sudo/env/timeout/unshare/setpriv have a conservative total count below 24; no fake calibration launches, Node probes, actors, workerd, package dependencies, or timer-driven business operations. Checkout/setup/upload are workflow support outside that target.
review.changeBoundary: Seven new 100644 leaves only. Full original S09 bytes are a read-only .txt mount referenced by the previously existing Git blob and exempted from the per-object cap. The sealed vector is reused byte-for-byte. The delta leaves 3,203 original BASE leaves and all 62 existing workflows intact when applied correctly.

performed: Node builtin SHA256 and Git-object SHA1 hash of UTF-8 DATA
Full Git blob readback and exact byte-equivalent string comparisons

remainingRootGates: Review the proposal on its exact mounted object set before any execution. Reconstruct the original literal slice and byte pins independently.

Check both nominated BASE identities, full leaf equality, absence of all new and output paths at BASE, and workflow scope and interactions with existing triggers. Create only the separately admitted addition-only tree and one commit/ref.

Admit only the exact nominated attempt-1 push. Verify head and tree metadata, tested Node version and custody, failed step/job, and the exact regular JSON evidence in artifact or independently matched stdout carrier.

Require the real baseline 503/g1 and the isolated private header mismatch at the private assertion stage, with child closure and temp readback. Treat early/late cutoff, cleanup uncertainty or any unrelated child failure as unaccepted. Review subsequent work separately.

rulings.decision: Use a model-only synthetic bodyless URL, matching error/response values and identity joins.
rulings.why: Exercise the actual legacy factory without launching actors, wiring business operations or using a live URL.
rulings.consideration: No assertion about native scheduling, T versus E, cursor state, QA delivery, or workerd.

rulings.decision: Always leave the RED-only workflow failing; distinguish a genuine unexpected GREEN in the tested child frame.
rulings.why: Never let a missing feature or other unexpected result appear as successful CI, while preserving the test unchanged for later GREEN reuse.
rulings.consideration: Job failure alone carries no admission evidence.

rulings.decision: Use namespace PID1 and targeted host-PID absence, without mounting an alternative procfs or claiming filesystem isolation.
rulings.why: Read back closure of the exact bounded named subprocess with an independent trusted parent after reap.
rulings.consideration: This only isolates the modeled network/PID launch and verifies named process/temp closure. No broader process or runtime drain.
